senses.en: inflammation of the appendix, which needs medical treatment

example.en: The severe stomach pain turned out to be appendicitis.
example.zh: 剧烈的腹痛原来是阑尾炎。

senses.en: not likely to upset or offend anyone; harmless

example.en: He made an inoffensive joke that made everyone smile.
example.zh: 他讲了个不冒犯任何人的笑话，逗得大家笑了。

senses.en: willing to take risks; adventurous

example.en: The venturesome hikers explored the unmarked trail.
example.zh: 这群大胆的徒步者探索了没有标记的小路。

senses.en: a person who flies a balloon
senses.zh: 气球驾驶员；乘气球飞行的人

example.en: The balloonist floated above the valley at sunrise.
example.zh: 气球驾驶员在日出时飘浮在山谷上空。

senses.en: medicines used to kill bacteria or stop their growth; plural of antibiotic

example.en: A doctor prescribed antibiotics for the bacterial infection.
example.zh: 医生为这种细菌感染开了抗生素。

senses.en: an unfair difference between groups of people, e.g. in wealth or status

example.en: The government promised to reduce income inequality.
example.zh: 政府承诺减少收入不平等。

senses.en: a mathematical statement that two expressions are not equal

example.en: Students learn to solve inequalities in algebra class.
example.zh: 学生在代数课上学习解不等式。

senses.en: not clear or sharp in outline or detail

example.en: The photo was old and fuzzy.
example.zh: 这张照片又旧又模糊。

senses.en: covered with soft fine hairs

example.en: The peach had fuzzy skin.
example.zh: 这桃子皮上有绒毛。

senses.en: kilogram, a unit of mass equal to 1,000 grams

example.en: The bag weighs five kg.
example.zh: 这个包重五公斤。

senses.en: the roof of the mouth separating the mouth from the nose

example.en: The dentist examined her palate.
example.zh: 牙医检查了她的上腭。

senses.en: a person's sense of taste

example.en: The dish should please most palates.
example.zh: 这道菜应该适合大多数人的口味。

senses.en: a sweet drink made from lemon juice, sugar and water

example.en: We drank cold lemonade on the hot afternoon.
example.zh: 炎热的下午我们喝了冰柠檬水。

senses.en: to some degree, but not completely

example.en: The success was partly due to luck.
example.zh: 这次成功部分归因于运气。

senses.en: the flat cutting part of a knife or tool

example.en: He sharpened the blade before cutting the rope.
example.zh: 他在割绳子之前磨快了刀片。

senses.en: a long, narrow leaf of grass

example.en: A light breeze moved the blades of grass.
example.zh: 微风拂动草叶。

senses.en: a flat part of a fan, propeller, or oar that pushes air or water
senses.zh: （风扇、螺旋桨或桨的）叶片，桨叶

example.en: One blade of the fan was bent.
example.zh: 风扇的一个叶片弯了。

senses.en: the highest point of a mountain or hill

example.en: Snow covered the summit by morning.
example.zh: 到早晨时，山顶已被雪覆盖。

senses.en: a high-level meeting between leaders

example.en: World leaders met at a climate summit.
example.zh: 世界各国领导人参加了一次气候峰会。

senses.en: to reach the top of a mountain

example.en: They summited the mountain before noon.
example.zh: 他们在中午前登上了山顶。

senses.en: to respect and like someone because of their qualities or actions
senses.zh: 因某人的品质或行为而尊敬、钦佩

example.en: I admire her honesty.
example.zh: 我钦佩她的诚实。

senses.en: to look at something with pleasure because it is beautiful or impressive

example.en: We stopped to admire the view.
example.zh: 我们停下来欣赏风景。

senses.en: a person or company that pays money to support an event, team, or organization

example.en: The local bank is the main sponsor of the festival.
example.zh: 当地银行是这个节日的主要赞助商。

senses.en: to pay money to support an event, team, or person

example.en: Several companies sponsor the annual race.
example.zh: 几家公司赞助这项年度赛事。

senses.en: to officially propose a law or resolution

example.en: She sponsored a bill to improve public transport.
example.zh: 她提出了一项改善公共交通的法案。

senses.en: a place where someone lives; a home

example.en: They moved to a new residence last month.
example.zh: 他们上个月搬进了新住所。

senses.en: the official home of an important person such as a president

example.en: The presidential residence is heavily guarded.
example.zh: 总统官邸守卫森严。

senses.en: the legal fact of living in a particular place

example.en: She has applied for permanent residence in Canada.
example.zh: 她已申请加拿大永久居留权。

senses.en: living; not dead

example.en: The rescued bird was still alive.
example.zh: 获救的鸟还活着。

senses.en: full of activity, energy, or living things

example.en: The market was alive with color and noise.
example.zh: 市场充满色彩和喧闹声。

senses.en: still existing or continuing
senses.zh: 仍然存在的；继续有效的

example.en: The old tradition is still alive.
example.zh: 这一古老传统仍然存在。

senses.en: to become red in the face because of embarrassment or shame

example.en: She blushed when everyone looked at her.
example.zh: 当大家都看着她时，她脸红了。

senses.en: a sudden reddening of the face from embarrassment or shame

example.en: A deep blush appeared on his cheeks.
example.zh: 他的脸颊泛起一阵深深的红晕。

senses.en: the middle of the day, around twelve o'clock

example.en: We usually take a short walk at midday.
example.zh: 我们通常在中午散一会儿步。

senses.en: a unit of power equal to one joule per second

example.en: This light bulb uses only ten watts.
example.zh: 这个灯泡的功率只有十瓦。

senses.en: a name of the Scottish engineer James Watt, who improved the steam engine (1736–1819)
senses.zh: 瓦特（苏格兰工程师，改良蒸汽机）

example.en: James Watt improved the design of the steam engine.
example.zh: 詹姆斯·瓦特改进了蒸汽机的设计。

senses.en: to travel across or pass through an area

example.en: They traversed the desert in two weeks.
example.zh: 他们用两周时间穿越了沙漠。

senses.en: to extend across or span an area

example.en: A railway line traverses the entire valley.
example.zh: 一条铁路线横贯整个山谷。

senses.en: a horizontal beam or crosspiece; also a passage across something

example.en: The carpenter fixed a traverse across the window frame.
example.zh: 木匠在窗框上安装了一根横档。

senses.en: present from birth; natural rather than learned

example.en: She has an innate talent for music.
example.zh: 她有音乐方面的天赋。

senses.en: a word that names a person, place, thing, quality, or action

example.en: In the sentence 'Dogs are loyal', 'dogs' is a noun.
example.zh: 在句子“Dogs are loyal”中，“dogs”是名词。

senses.en: toward the north

example.en: The birds flew northward in spring.
example.zh: 春天鸟儿向北飞去。

senses.en: moving or facing toward the north

example.en: The ship took a northward course.
example.zh: 船取道向北航线。

senses.en: a market, especially one in the Middle East or South Asia with many small shops and stalls

example.en: We bought spices and carpets at the old bazaar in Istanbul.
example.zh: 我们在伊斯坦布尔的老巴扎买了香料和地毯。

senses.en: a sale of used or handmade goods to raise money for charity

example.en: The school is holding a charity bazaar next Saturday.
example.zh: 学校下周六举办慈善义卖会。

senses.en: an official decision made by a court or judge

example.en: The court issued a ruling in favor of the defendant.
example.zh: 法院作出了有利于被告的裁定。

senses.en: having power and control over others; dominant

example.en: The ruling party won the election again.
example.zh: 执政党再次赢得选举。

senses.en: a wooden instrument with a graphite core used for writing or drawing

example.en: I wrote my name with a pencil.
example.zh: 我用铅笔写下了我的名字。

senses.en: a small cosmetic stick, such as for the eyebrows or eyes

example.en: She used an eyebrow pencil before going out.
example.zh: 她出门前用了眉笔。

senses.en: to write or draw something with a pencil, often lightly or temporarily

example.en: He pencilled a note in the margin.
example.zh: 他在页边用铅笔写了批注。

senses.en: Jordan, a country in the Middle East, in western Asia

example.en: Amman is the capital of Jordan.
example.zh: 安曼是约旦的首都。

senses.en: the Jordan, a river in the Middle East flowing into the Dead Sea

example.en: The Jordan River flows into the Dead Sea.
example.zh: 约旦河流入死海。

senses.en: a surname, as of basketball player Michael Jordan

example.en: Michael Jordan is a famous basketball player.
example.zh: 迈克尔·乔丹是著名的篮球运动员。

senses.en: a characteristic way of thinking or attitude

example.en: A positive mentality helps people overcome difficulties.
example.zh: 积极的心态帮助人们克服困难。

senses.en: to break or damage something completely

example.en: He busted his watch when he dropped it on the floor.
example.zh: 手表掉在地板上时他把它摔坏了。

senses.en: a sculpture of the head and shoulders of a person

example.en: A marble bust of the poet stands in the library.
example.zh: 图书馆里立着这位诗人的一尊大理石半身像。

senses.en: a complete failure, especially of a business

example.en: The show was a complete bust.
example.zh: 这场演出彻底失败了。

senses.en: completely without money

example.en: The company went bust after sales collapsed.
example.zh: 销售崩溃后公司破产了。

senses.en: feeling anxious or concerned about something

example.en: She looked worried when she heard the news.
example.zh: 她听到这个消息时显得很担心。

senses.en: showing calm acceptance of something unpleasant

example.en: He gave a resigned shrug when the flight was cancelled.
example.zh: 航班取消时，他无奈地耸了耸肩。

senses.en: past tense and past participle of resign: to leave a job or position formally
senses.zh: resign（辞职）的过去式和过去分词

example.en: The manager resigned last month.
example.zh: 那位经理上个月辞职了。

senses.en: a building with a domed ceiling where images of stars and planets are shown

example.en: The children visited the planetarium to learn about the solar system.
example.zh: 孩子们参观了天文馆，了解太阳系。

senses.en: the projector that displays images of celestial bodies on a dome

example.en: The planetarium projected thousands of stars onto the dome.
example.zh: 天象仪将数千颗星星投射到穹顶上。

senses.en: relating to philosophy or philosophers

example.en: The book explores philosophic questions about existence.
example.zh: 这本书探讨了关于存在的哲学问题。

senses.en: calm and accepting when facing difficulties

example.en: He stayed philosophic about the setback.
example.zh: 他对这次挫折泰然处之。

senses.en: a feeling of deep, bitter resentment or ill will

example.en: She bore no rancor toward her former business partner.
example.zh: 她对从前的生意伙伴毫无怨恨。

senses.en: official permission not to follow a rule or obligation

example.en: The students were given a dispensation from wearing uniforms.
example.zh: 学生们获得了免穿校服的特许。

senses.en: a system or order of things, especially in a particular era
senses.zh: 体制；时期（尤指历史上的阶段）

example.en: The new economic dispensation changed the country's trade laws.
example.zh: 新的经济体制改变了该国的贸易法。

senses.en: a sweet orange fruit that is edible when fully ripe, or the tree it grows on

example.en: The persimmon is only sweet when it is completely ripe.
example.zh: 柿子只有完全成熟时才甜。

senses.en: an edible shellfish with a fan-shaped shell

example.en: We ordered grilled scallops at the restaurant.
example.zh: 我们在餐厅点了烤扇贝。

senses.en: one of a series of rounded curves along an edge

example.en: The dress has a scallop at the hem.
example.zh: 这条裙子的下摆有扇形边。

senses.en: to decorate an edge with rounded curves

example.en: She scalloped the edge of the pie crust.
example.zh: 她给派皮的边缘做了扇形花边。

senses.en: (cooking) to bake food, especially sliced potatoes, in a sauce
senses.zh: （烹饪）将食物（尤指土豆片）加酱汁烘烤

example.en: She scalloped the potatoes in cream.
example.zh: 她将土豆片加奶油烘烤。

senses.en: a game played on horseback using long-handled mallets and a ball

example.en: They watched a polo match on Sunday.
example.zh: 他们周日观看了一场马球比赛。

senses.en: a game similar to swimming handball played in a pool

example.en: Water polo is an Olympic sport.
example.zh: 水球是一项奥运会项目。

senses.en: a shirt with a collar and short sleeves

example.en: He wore a polo shirt to the picnic.
example.zh: 他穿着Polo衫去野餐。

senses.en: special words used by a particular group or profession that are hard for outsiders to understand

example.en: The contract was full of legal jargon.
example.zh: 这份合同满是法律术语。

senses.en: an organism with a changed gene or chromosome, differing from the normal form

example.en: Scientists studied the mutant under a microscope.
example.zh: 科学家在显微镜下研究这个突变体。

senses.en: resulting from or involving genetic mutation

example.en: The fruit flies carry a mutant gene.
example.zh: 这些果蝇携带一个突变基因。

senses.en: a roofed open porch along the outside of a house

example.en: We sat on the veranda watching the rain.
example.zh: 我们坐在游廊上看雨。

senses.en: showing a wide view of a broad area

example.en: The hotel room has a panoramic view of the sea.
example.zh: 这间酒店房间能饱览海景全景。

senses.en: a set of instructions that makes a computer do something

example.en: She wrote a program to sort the names.
example.zh: 她写了一个程序来给这些名字排序。

senses.en: a planned set of activities or events

example.en: The school runs a summer reading program.
example.zh: 学校开展了一项暑期阅读计划。

senses.en: a show on television or radio

example.en: This program is about wild animals.
example.zh: 这个节目是关于野生动物的。

senses.en: to write instructions for a computer or machine

example.en: He programmed the robot to pick up the box.
example.zh: 他给机器人编程，让它拿起盒子。

senses.en: the right or ability to act, speak, or choose without being controlled

example.en: She values the freedom to make her own choices.
example.zh: 她珍视自己作选择的自由。

senses.en: the state of not being held prisoner or enslaved

example.en: The prisoners finally gained their freedom.
example.zh: 囚犯们终于获得了自由。

senses.en: a particular right or privilege that people are allowed to have

example.en: Academic freedom is important for good research.
example.zh: 学术自由对高质量研究很重要。

senses.en: belief in and worship of a god or gods, and the practices connected with it
senses.zh: 对神或诸神的信仰与崇拜及相关活动

example.en: Religion has shaped the laws and customs of many societies.
example.zh: 宗教塑造了许多社会的法律和习俗。

senses.en: one of the organized systems of faith and worship, such as Christianity or Islam
senses.zh: 基督教、伊斯兰教等有组织的宗教信仰体系

example.en: She studied several religions at university.
example.zh: 她在大学研究过几种宗教。

senses.en: something that someone cares about or follows with great devotion
senses.zh: 某人极为热衷并奉行的东西

example.en: For him, music is almost a religion.
example.zh: 对他来说，音乐几乎是一种信仰。

senses.en: a group of people or things that share common features; a kind

example.en: This type of tea is grown in the mountains.
example.zh: 这种茶生长在山里。

senses.en: to write something using a keyboard

example.en: She typed the report in ten minutes.
example.zh: 她十分钟就打完了报告。

senses.en: printed letters or characters, especially in a particular style or size

example.en: The small type at the bottom was hard to read.
example.zh: 底部的小字很难看清。

senses.en: a hard, usually transparent material used for windows and bottles

example.en: The bottle is made of glass.
example.zh: 这个瓶子是玻璃做的。

senses.en: a container made of glass for drinking

example.en: She poured water into a glass.
example.zh: 她把水倒进一个玻璃杯里。

senses.en: to fit or cover something with glass

example.en: They glassed in the balcony to make a sunroom.
example.zh: 他们给阳台装上玻璃，做成日光房。

senses.en: used in the plural (glasses): lenses in a frame worn to help someone see

example.en: She put on her glasses to read.
example.zh: 她戴上眼镜看书。

senses.en: the official organization that catches criminals and keeps public order

example.en: The police arrived within minutes.
example.zh: 警察几分钟内就到了。

senses.en: to keep order and enforce the law in an area or event

example.en: Officers policed the crowd during the parade.
example.zh: 游行期间，警察在人群中维持治安。

senses.en: to monitor an activity and make sure rules are followed

example.en: The committee polices the use of public funds.
example.zh: 委员会监督公共资金的使用。

senses.en: a horse-drawn vehicle with wheels

example.en: They rode through the park in an open carriage.
example.zh: 他们乘着一辆敞篷马车穿过公园。

senses.en: a railway passenger vehicle

example.en: Our seats were in the last carriage of the train.
example.zh: 我们的座位在火车最后一节车厢。

senses.en: the way a person holds and moves their body

example.en: She had the graceful carriage of a dancer.
example.zh: 她有着舞者般优雅的仪态。

senses.en: to walk through shallow water

example.en: We took off our shoes and waded across the stream.
example.zh: 我们脱掉鞋子，蹚水过溪。

senses.en: to make one's way slowly and with effort through something difficult
senses.zh: 艰难地进行；费力地处理

example.en: She had to wade through pages of paperwork before signing the contract.
example.zh: 她不得不费力地看完厚厚的文件才签合同。

senses.en: to put someone in prison or keep them locked up as a punishment

example.en: He was imprisoned for three years for fraud.
example.zh: 他因诈骗被监禁了三年。

senses.en: to restrict or trap someone as if in a prison

example.en: Fear had imprisoned her for years.
example.zh: 恐惧禁锢了她多年。

senses.en: to make something officially or legally valid

example.en: The clerk validated the contract.
example.zh: 职员确认该合同有效。

senses.en: to prove or confirm that something is correct

example.en: The study validated the earlier findings.
example.zh: 这项研究证实了早先的发现。

senses.en: the quality of being very strict, careful, and thorough

example.en: The study was praised for its scientific rigor.
example.zh: 这项研究因其科学上的严谨而受到称赞。

senses.en: harsh or severe conditions; hardship

example.en: The prisoners suffered the rigors of a long winter.
example.zh: 囚犯们经受了漫长冬天的严酷。

senses.en: the act of following rules, beliefs, or plans closely

example.en: Strict adherence to the schedule is required.
example.zh: 必须严格遵守时间表。

senses.en: the quality of sticking to a surface

example.en: The paint shows good adherence to the metal.
example.zh: 这漆对金属的附着力很好。

senses.en: a worker whose job is to pack things into containers

example.en: A packer sealed each box before it was shipped.
example.zh: 装箱工人在发货前把每个箱子封好。

senses.en: the number of births per thousand people in a population per year

example.en: The country's birthrate has fallen sharply in recent decades.
example.zh: 近几十年该国出生率急剧下降。

senses.en: something very ugly to look at, especially a building or structure
senses.zh: 刺眼的东西，难看的景象

example.en: The abandoned factory is an eyesore in the neighborhood.
example.zh: 那座废弃的工厂是社区里一大刺眼的景象。

senses.en: the emperor of Russia before 1917

example.en: Peter the Great was one of the most famous tsars of Russia.
example.zh: 彼得大帝是俄国最著名的沙皇之一。

senses.en: an official with great power over a policy area (informal, mainly US)
senses.zh: （主管某领域的）权威官员，大佬

example.en: He was appointed the government's new drug tsar.
example.zh: 他被任命为政府新的禁毒主管。

senses.en: to make something more beautiful

example.en: The city planted flowers to beautify the streets.
example.zh: 市政府种植鲜花来美化街道。

senses.en: the group of people with high social rank and hereditary titles

example.en: In medieval times, the nobility owned most of the land.
example.zh: 在中世纪，贵族拥有大部分土地。

senses.en: the quality of being noble in character or ideals

example.en: She was admired for the nobility of her ideals.
example.zh: 她因理想高尚而受人钦佩。

senses.en: clever and quick to see how to gain an advantage

example.en: He made an astute business decision.
example.zh: 他做出了一个精明的商业决定。

senses.en: a false idea or belief based on wrong reasoning

example.en: It is a common fallacy that money always brings happiness.
example.zh: 金钱总能带来幸福是一种常见的谬见。

senses.en: lack of power or ability to act effectively

example.en: He felt a sense of impotence when he could not help his friend.
example.zh: 当无法帮助朋友时，他感到一种无力感。

senses.en: inability to have sex, especially in men (medical use)

example.en: The doctor discussed possible causes of impotence with the patient.
example.zh: 医生与病人讨论了阳痿的可能原因。

senses.en: to clean and repair a building or object so it is in good condition again

example.en: The hotel was refurbished last year.
example.zh: 这家酒店去年进行了翻新。

senses.en: having many different aspects or qualities

example.en: Climate change is a multifaceted problem.
example.zh: 气候变化是一个多方面的问题。

senses.en: to make an unpleasant feeling less severe

example.en: A warm drink can assuage your anxiety before the interview.
example.zh: 面试前喝点热饮可以缓解你的焦虑。

senses.en: emotions such as happiness, sadness, or anger

example.en: It's hard to describe my feelings about moving to a new city.
example.zh: 很难描述我对搬到新城市的感受。

senses.en: indirect suggestions or small pieces of advice or information

example.en: She dropped several hints about wanting a new bike for her birthday.
example.zh: 她多次暗示生日时想要一辆新自行车。

senses.en: very small amounts or slight traces

example.en: There were hints of cinnamon in the dessert.
example.zh: 这道甜点里有一丝肉桂的味道。

senses.en: who a person is; the qualities that make someone recognizable

example.en: The witnesses were asked to keep their identities secret.
